Journey log

Change, with context attached.

20 records

Sep 3, 2026

Site update

Put engineering evidence first and clarified privacy boundaries

Updated first-year positioning, led with four tested repositories, made the fieldbook easier to navigate, and separated optional session identity from aggregate analytics. Historical learning metrics retain their original values.

Aug 24, 2026

Site update

Added optional Google identity with a visible privacy boundary

I wanted to explore identity design without turning a public portfolio into a data-collection system, so the sign-in is optional, session-only, and paired with a plain-language privacy map.

Aug 24, 2026

Portfolio update

Added three tested electrical and computer engineering labs

I wanted the fieldbook to connect responsible-technology principles with concrete evidence from power-quality analysis, microgrid controls, and defensive CAN monitoring.

Aug 10, 2026

Portfolio update

Connected the fieldbook to my GitHub projects

I wanted visitors to move easily from the ideas in this portfolio to a concrete, tested software project and the source work behind it.

Aug 2, 2026

Site update

Rebuilt the portfolio as Signal & Self

The project needed a clearer identity, a calmer visual system, richer navigation, and a structure that feels like a living fieldbook rather than a set of disconnected pages.

Aug 1, 2026

Reflection

Published a field note on privacy by design

I wanted to record how data minimization changed a prototype before its feature list became fixed.

Jul 24, 2026

Project

Completed an accessible forms review card

A compact checklist makes it easier to catch interaction barriers before a form is shared.

Jul 18, 2026

Reflection

Connected threat modeling with user empathy

Security became more practical when I considered ordinary confusion and pressure alongside deliberate attacks.

Jul 3, 2026

Community contribution

Documented repository hygiene as communication work

Clear structure and useful context make technical work easier for other people to understand and continue.

Jun 11, 2026

Reflection

Added accessibility to the citizenship framework

Responsible participation has to include whether other people can access and operate the spaces we build.

May 22, 2026

Media literacy

Added a field note on source tracing in persuasive video

Visual polish can feel like proof, so I wanted a record of checking the evidence behind confident presentation.

Apr 19, 2026

Site update

Added an interactive Digital Adoption world map with a year slider

I wanted the dashboard to connect personal statistics with a broader regional view of how internet adoption spread over time.

Apr 19, 2026

Reflection

Expanded the reflection archive back to August 21, 2025

I wanted the site to show a longer timeline of growth rather than only the most recent months of reflection.

Apr 19, 2026

Site update

Added a personal About Me section and international youth digital citizenship statistics

I wanted the site to reflect my background as an incoming electrical engineering student in Canada while giving visitors reliable global context and learn-more resources.

Apr 18, 2026

Site update

Added a dashboard view for weekly and monthly learning progress

I wanted the site to show progress over time instead of isolated totals.

Apr 17, 2026

Reflection

Published a reflection on fact-checking AI summaries

It marked a useful shift from convenience-first research to evidence-first research.

Apr 14, 2026

Community contribution

Expanded the peer support mini library with safety and citation resources

Classmates needed practical links they could use quickly without sorting through long articles.

Apr 9, 2026

Ethical technology use

Drafted a personal guide for responsible AI use

I wanted clearer boundaries for when AI helps and when it risks weakening accountability.

Apr 5, 2026

Created a starter checklist for privacy settings on new apps

Sign in

Sign in with Google to personalize your greeting during this browser session. Sign-in does not unlock private content or create a permanent account. Anonymous traffic and performance metrics are measured separately through Cloudflare Web Analytics.
